Senses.PreferredTarget: the cypress tree in the garden
AlternateTargets: the cypress tree in front of the courtyard
Senses.Explanation: Zhaozhou's answer to the stock question "what is the meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West?" (如何是祖師西來意): (庭前柏樹子) — the cypress tree in front of the hall. The word (柏) is the cypress/arborvitae of Chinese temple yards, an evergreen. In his own record the exchange continues: the monk says "Master, don't show people by way of an object" (和尚莫將境示人), Zhaozhou answers "I do not show people by way of an object" (我不將境示人), and to the question asked again gives the identical answer (庭前柏樹子). Zhaozhou speaks of the same tree elsewhere: asked (柏樹子還有佛性也無) (does the cypress have buddha-nature) he says (有); asked (幾時成佛) he says "when empty space falls to the ground" (待虛空落地); asked (虛空幾時落地) he says "when the cypress becomes a buddha" (待柏樹子成佛). The exchange hardened into a named case — (無門關) case 37 (headed 庭前柏樹) and (從容錄) case 47 (趙州柏樹; the case-name occurs 49 times / 34 files, plus the 趙州栢樹 graph 46 / 23) — raised constantly across the record: the answer stands within eight characters of (西來意) in 256 places across 111 files, and raw grep gives (庭前柏樹子) 401 hits / 151 files plus the variant graph (庭前栢樹子) 167 / 55 (bare 柏樹子 650 / 185; 栢樹子 313 / 65). Attested handlings of the raised case: (無門) comments (若向趙州答處)。(見得親切)。(前無釋迦)。(後無彌勒); (五祖法演) tells his assembly (恁麼會則不是了也) … (恁麼會方始是) (understood this way it is wrong; understood that way it is right); (圜悟) gives the bare phrase to the monk Anmin — (悟曰)。(庭前柏樹子)。(師即洞明). The record also carries a denial of the case: (法眼) asks (慧覺) (覺鐵嘴, Zhaozhou's heir) (承聞趙州有柏樹子話是否), (覺曰)。(無), and to the objection "everyone coming and going says so" (往來皆謂) answers "my late master really had no such saying — do not slander him" (先師實無此語。和尚莫謗先師好; 先師實無此語 19 hits / 17 files, 先師無此語 42 / 31, told in 從容錄 directly after case 47 and in 五燈會元's 光孝慧覺 section); the denial is itself then put to later masters — in (五燈會元) a monk presses (大溈慕喆) with (先師無此語)。(又作麼生).
Senses.Note: The famous older English rendering "the oak tree in the garden" is a mistranslation: (柏) is cypress (Platycladus / Chinese arborvitae), not oak. Attribution rule applied: the case is Zhaozhou's own (his record, J24nB137, carries his name); every later citation — (無門關) case 37, (從容錄) case 47, (五祖法演)'s (拈古), (圜悟)'s use with Anmin, the (覺鐵嘴) denial exchange — is a raising of Zhaozhou's case and is left MasterName=null.

Occurrences.Kwic: 時有僧問：「如何是祖師西來意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」學云：「和尚莫將境示人。」師云：「我不將境示人。」云：「如何是祖師西來意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (趙州祖師語錄) (Zhaozhou's own record); (師) = Zhaozhou. The locus classicus, including the (我不將境示人) rider.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「柏樹子還有佛性也無？」師云：「有。」云：「幾時成佛？」師云：「待虛空落地。」云：「虛空幾時落地？」師云：「待柏樹子成佛。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zhaozhou's second play on the cypress (its buddha-nature). The head term (庭前柏樹子) is abbreviated to (柏樹子) here.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧便問。如何是祖師西來意。州云。庭前柏樹子。僧云。和尚莫將境示人。師云。不將境示人。僧云。然則如何是祖師西來意。師云。庭前柏樹子。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (從容錄) case 47 ("趙州柏樹"): Zhaozhou's case set up for verse-commentary. Raised case → null.

Occurrences.Kwic: 五祖示眾：如何是祖師西來意？庭前柏樹子。恁麼會則不是了也。如何是祖師西來意？庭前柏樹子。恁麼會方始是。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (宗門拈古彙集); (五祖法演) (Wuzu Fayan) raises Zhaozhou's case in his (示眾) (this way wrong / that way right). Raised case → null.

Occurrences.Kwic: 悟曰。你問我。師舉前話。悟曰。庭前柏樹子。師即洞明。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (五燈會元), (密印安民) section; (悟) (圜悟克勤 / Yuanwu Keqin) hands Zhaozhou's phrase to Anmin, who at once penetrates. Raised case → null.

Senses.Explanation: Vimalakirti is the pre-Zen householder whom Chan masters repeatedly raise in public interviews and comments. His name occurs 263 times in 116 allowlisted texts. The dominant Zen deployment is the sickroom exchange: Manjusri asks him to state the entry into the gate of not-two, Vimalakirti remains silent, and Manjusri praises the absence of speech and writing. Later masters do not leave that episode uncontested. Xuedou asks, "what did Vimalakirti say?" (維摩道甚麼) and says he has examined him through; another master says both Vimalakirti and Manjusri deserve thirty blows; public questions repeatedly ask the purport of "Vimalakirti's one silence" (維摩一默). A direct answer to that question is "Hanshan visits Shide" (寒山訪拾得), followed by a hiss when the monk labels it the gate of not-two. The Zen Vimalakirti is therefore the seated, silent figure whom masters question, rebuke, praise, and reuse in interviews—not a imported account of his life.
Senses.Note: One person sense covers the evidence. Occurrences inside scripture titles still use the person's name as a title constituent and do not establish a second thing denoted by the bare headword. The shorter form Vimalakirti (維摩) is the dominant variant and belongs to the same figure family.

Occurrences.Kwic: 文殊又問維摩：仁者當說，何等是菩薩入不二法門？維摩默然。文殊讚曰：乃至無有語言文字，是菩薩真入不二法門。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The record states the question, Vimalakirti's silence, and Manjusri's praise.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪竇云：維摩道甚麼？又云：勘破了也。琅瑘覺云：文殊贊善，也是杓卜聽虗聲。維摩默然。汝等諸人，不得鑽龜打瓦。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Later masters ask what Vimalakirti said, claim to have examined him, and criticize Manjusri's praise.

Occurrences.Kwic: 維摩一默，文殊贊善，若遇老僧在彼，各與三十棒。且道這二老漢過在什麼處？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: A master says he would give Vimalakirti and Manjusri thirty blows and asks where their fault lies.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：如何是維摩一默？師云：寒山訪拾得。僧曰：恁麼則入不二之門。師云：噓。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: A public question on Vimalakirti's silence receives “Hanshan visits Shide,” followed by a hiss at the monk's conclusion.

Occurrences.Kwic: 維摩詰居士住毘耶離城，因示疾次，世尊敕文殊領諸大弟子共維摩詰問疾。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The frame names Vimalakirti as the sick householder and Manjusri's visit as an inquiry after illness.

Occurrences.Kwic: 維摩杜口於毘耶離城，喫鹽止渴。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: A hall address calls Vimalakirti shutting his mouth in Vaisali 'eating salt to stop thirst.'
